LESSON: ENTERPRISE PROJECTS ENVIRONMENT

Grade: Grade 3
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
Strand: Social 2.1 Harmonious By the end of the sub-strand,  Learners to visit a market
Topic 2.2: Enterprise projects environment

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Enterprise projects environment. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. respond appropriately to  In groups, learners to reflect, share and report strangers in the back their experiences about responding to community strangers

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: ENTERPRISE PROJECTS ENVIRONMENT
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES · Grade: Grade 3
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Enterprise projects environment helps you succeed in ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES. You will understand it, practise it, and use it in your school compound, home, farm, or county.

KEY FACTS: ENTERPRISE PROJECTS ENVIRONMENT
Study Enterprise projects environment like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.
Replace teacher words with your own words.
If a step is unclear, rewrite it shorter and try again.

PART 1: Respond appropriately to  In groups, learners to reflect, share and report strangers in the back their experiences about responding to community strangers

What this means
In this part you learn to respond appropriately to  In groups, learners to reflect, share and report strangers in the back their experiences about responding to community strangers. You will use ideas from in your school compound, home, farm, or county.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: respond appropriately to  In groups, learners to reflect, share and report strangers in the back their experiences about responding to community strangers.
2. Observe, explain, then apply using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Observe: Name what you can see/touch about “Enterprise projects environment” around your school.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can respond appropriately to  In groups, learners to reflect, share and report strangers in the back their experiences about responding to community strangers. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Enterprise projects environment is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Name what you can see/touch about “Enterprise projects environment” around your school. (skill: respond appropriately to  In groups, learners to reflect, share and report strangers in the back their experiences about responding to community strangers)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Enterprise projects environment to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: respond appropriately to  In groups, learners to reflect, share and report strangers in the back their experiences about responding to community strangers.
3. Make one local Kenya example of Enterprise projects environment from your county, market, farm, or school.
4. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Enterprise projects environment: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 3 learner study Enterprise projects environment?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Enterprise projects environment means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: respond appropriately to  In groups, learners to reflect, share and report strangers in the back their experiences about responding to community strangers.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
